attrs.summary: The Patient Authentication & Profile Management module enables patients to securely register, authenticate, and manage their personal profiles within the Hairline platform.
FR-002 defines shared backend engines for processing medical intake data and head media, consumed by FR-003 (Inquiry) and others.

The Inquiry Submission & Distribution module enables patients to submit comprehensive treatment requests through the mobile app, which are then automatically distributed to relevant providers based on location and availability.
The Quote Submission & Management module enables providers to create, edit, submit, and manage detailed quote responses for distributed patient inquiries.
The Quote Comparison & Acceptance module enables patients to review quotes from multiple providers, including multiple parent quotes from the same provider.
Enable patients to convert one accepted subquote into a confirmed procedure booking by paying a deposit or first installment.

Enable patients to pay securely for procedures (deposit at booking and final payment before or on procedure day) in supported currencies and methods, while ensuring compliant handling of payments, automated receipt/invoice generation, platform commission calculation, and timely provider payouts after treatment completion.

Enable patients to pay for hair transplant procedures through interest-free installment plans spanning 2-9 months, providing financial flexibility while ensuring full payment completion 30 days before the scheduled procedure date.
Enable coordinated travel logistics for patients and providers across the full appointment lifecycle.

The Provider Team & Role Management feature enables multi-user collaboration within provider organizations by allowing clinic owners to invite team members, assign role-based permissions, and manage access to the Hairline platform.
The Treatment Execution & Documentation module enables providers to document the entire hair transplant procedure lifecycle from patient arrival through treatment completion.

The Aftercare & Recovery Management module provides comprehensive post-procedure support for hair transplant patients through milestone-based tracking, scan monitoring, questionnaire assessments, and multi-tenant communication.

Enable secure, auditable, real-time messaging and audio/video communication between patients and providers across the Hairline platform to support quote clarification, procedure coordination, and patient care.

Enable patients with completed treatment cases to submit post-procedure reviews with structured ratings and optional photos, published immediately upon submission (no pre-publication moderation gate).
The Provider Analytics & Reporting module delivers a 13-screen suite (12 analytical + 1 export config) split across two tenants: provider and admin.
The Provider Management module enables administrators to onboard and manage hair transplant providers who will serve patients through the Hairline platform.
The Admin Patient Management module provides Hairline internal administrators with comprehensive oversight and management capabilities for all patient accounts and activities across the platform.

The Admin Billing & Financial Management module provides Hairline administrators with comprehensive tools to manage the platform's financial operations across all stakeholders (patients, providers, and affiliates).
The Affiliate Management module enables Hairline to partner with external entities (influencers, clinics, organizations) who promote the platform in exchange for commission-based compensation.
Define, approve, and apply discounts across the Hairline platform with clear governance and auditability.
Provide reliable, configurable notifications (email, push, optional SMS in future phases) for key lifecycle events across patients and providers.
FR-021 defines Hairline's multi-language and localization capability across the Patient App, Provider Dashboard, Admin Platform, and system-delivered communications.
Search and filtering capabilities are critical for enabling users to efficiently navigate large datasets across the Hairline platform.
Establish organization-wide data retention, auditability, and privacy controls to meet healthcare and financial record-keeping obligations while honoring user privacy rights.
The Treatment & Package Management module establishes a two-tier content management system for medical procedures and service packages within the Hairline platform.

The Medical Questionnaire Management module enables administrators to manage a central catalog of questionnaire sets, where each set is a named, versioned package of questions (e.g., "Medical Safety Screening", "Pain Assessment", "Sleep Quality Check").

The App Settings & Security Policies module provides a centralized, audited, and versioned configuration surface for application-wide settings, security policies, app data lists, and notification templates that affect multiple modules and tenants (Patient, Provider, Admin).
Provide centralized management of legal content (Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Consent forms, Cancellation Policy) with versioning, preview, publishing, acceptance tracking, and audit trail.

The Regional Configuration & Pricing module enables Hairline administrators to control how treatment locations (countries/cities) are presented to patients and set starting price estimates for different regions and currencies.
The Payment System Configuration module empowers platform administrators to manage the complete payment infrastructure for the Hairline multi-tenant platform.
The Notification Rules & Configuration module provides comprehensive administrative control over the Hairline platform's notification system.

The Admin Access Control & Permissions module is a Super Admin-only configuration tool that serves as the single source of truth for all role definitions and permission matrices across the entire Hairline platform.

Provider Dashboard Settings & Profile Management enables clinic administrators and staff to configure their organization's profile, account settings, notification preferences, billing information, and team member permissions.
The Help Centre Content Management module provides a centralized knowledge base and support system for both provider and patient platforms.
The Support Center & Ticketing System provides a unified formal support system for managing both patient and provider inquiries, technical issues, feedback submissions, and general support requests.
The Patient Help Center & Support Submission module provides the patient-facing interface for accessing self-service help content and submitting support requests directly from the patient mobile app.
Monitor Your Hair Loss gives a patient a structured, longitudinal record of their hair-loss condition before they decide whether to request treatment.

Monitor Your Transplant Progress is a self-service utility for patients whose hair transplant may have been performed outside Hairline and who want to record recovery progress without buying an aftercare package.

nodes.title: Shared treatment version and one to five package options

attrs.statement: Providers MUST create, edit, and submit parent quotes with one shared immutable Treatment-version relationship and one to five package-based Quote Options. Technique details MUST be loaded read-only through that relationship and MUST NOT be duplicated as provider-entered Quote data.

nodes.title: Admin-controlled expiry window captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the admin-controlled FR-026 expiry window (default 48h), captured at first send, and compute the deadline per sent quote.

nodes.title: Competing quotes cancelled on subquote acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel every other parent quote for the same inquiry as `cancelled_other_accepted` upon one subquote acceptance. Each sent parent quote MUST produce one not-selected notice per parent quote; unsent drafts MUST be cancelled silently without notice.

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal after acceptance hands over to FR-006

attrs.statement: System MUST support provider withdrawal after acceptance by moving the parent quote to `withdrawn`, keeping the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot unchanged, and handing the case to the FR-006 provider-fault transfer, with full audit and the mandatory `quote.withdrawn` notice.

nodes.title: Admin inline edit of draft and sent quotes

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to inline edit policy-bound fields of `draft` and `sent` quotes with required reason and re-notifications; admin edits MUST be blocked once a subquote is accepted.

nodes.title: Quote references inquiry and patient and appends only

attrs.statement: Quotes MUST reference original inquiry and patient; quote data appends, never overwrites inquiry data.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules restate it: quotes MUST reference the distributed inquiry ID and be linked to the original patient object; no reduction or overwriting of inquiry-supplied fields; downstream stages inherit upstream data.

nodes.title: Edits and transitions versioned and auditable

attrs.statement: All quote edits and state transitions MUST be versioned and auditable.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules and Workflow 3 restate it: all state transitions (draft to sent to expired, etc.) MUST be fully auditable, are logged, and result in notifications as appropriate.

attrs.statement: Patient identifiers MUST remain anonymized to providers until payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: patient information remains censored at this stage until payment confirmation; only anonymized identifiers and allowed fields are visible to providers. Screen 3 hides contact until payment.

attrs.statement: All quote data MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit; soft deletes only.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: quotes CANNOT be hard deleted (only archived/soft deleted).

attrs.statement: Module MUST integrate with FR-003 for inquiry context and FR-020 for notifications.

nodes.title: Admin settings applied from FR-026 quote configuration

attrs.statement: Admin settings (quote expiry window, quote-expiring-soon lead time, and quote currency) MUST be applied from the FR-026 quote configuration.

nodes.title: Money on withdrawal follows FR-006 placeholder

attrs.statement: Money handling for provider withdrawal after acceptance follows the FR-006 provider-fault placeholder; exact refund and payment-allocation mechanics are owned by FR-007, FR-007B, and FR-017.

System MUST auto-cancel only the draft, sent, and expired quotes for an inquiry when that inquiry is cancelled by the patient (FR-003 Workflow 5), with distinct status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)"; quotes in any other status MUST keep their status and cause; `quote.cancelled_inquiry` (FR-020) MUST go only to providers whose quotes were cancelled by this cascade.
attrs.rationale: The cascade is system-initiated, not a provider or patient action on the quote itself.

nodes.title: Multiple parent quotes per provider per inquiry

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the same provider to create multiple parent quotes for one active inquiry; every quote retains an independent lifecycle, expiry, version history, and audit history.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: each inquiry may have multiple parent quotes from multiple providers or from the same provider; package alternatives within a parent quote are Quote Options, not independent quote responses.

nodes.title: One to five ordered Quote Options

attrs.statement: Each quote MUST contain between one and five ordered Quote Options, and submission MUST be blocked outside that range.

nodes.title: Option keeps source package and quote-owned snapshot

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST retain the selected provider package ID/version and a stable, versioned quote-owned snapshot of its inclusions and standard values.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: selecting a package MUST create a quote-owned snapshot.

nodes.title: Inline customization never touches the package library

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to customize every selected package inline for the current quote without updating or creating reusable package-library records.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: inline option customization MUST NOT update or create reusable package-library records.

nodes.title: Applicable date ranges and complete option/date pricing

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST define at least one applicable patient-requested date range and a price, appointment date/time, timezone, and optional structured promotion for every applicable option/date combination. Pairings the provider cannot offer MAY be left out.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers must select option applicability from patient-requested date ranges; a parent quote yields up to (options x date ranges) subquotes; unavailable combinations are omitted rather than priced; each priced pairing becomes one subquote for FR-005.

nodes.title: Separate relative day plan per option

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST own a separate ordered day-to-day treatment plan using consecutive relative day numbers.

nodes.title: Shared clinical facts stay on the parent quote

attrs.statement: Estimated grafts, graft description, visual treatment plan, clinicians, common notes, and common requirements MUST remain shared parent-quote fields.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: these MUST NOT be duplicated as option-specific facts.

attrs.statement: Quote version and audit records MUST capture the complete parent-and-options aggregate atomically, including option additions/removals, package snapshots, inclusion changes, date-price changes, and option plan changes.

nodes.title: Stable identifiers and aggregate subquote version

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST expose stable identifiers for the parent quote, Quote Option, and option/date price so FR-005 can record exactly one accepted option/date combination. FR-004 versions the complete parent quote aggregate atomically; therefore, the FR-005 `subquoteVersion` MUST equal the owning parent quote's current `QuoteVersion`. Quote Options and option/date-price records do not have independent revision counters.

Provider Quote Creation/Edit MUST use the ordered seven-tab flow defined in Screen 1, including Sub-screen 2A for quote-local package editing and one combined Dates & Pricing tab driven by the selected package options.

Every Quote, Quote Option, option item, option/date price, and option plan-day field MUST follow the Screen 1 Quote Data Ownership Matrix, with exactly one provider-editing surface or an explicit read-only/system-derived owner.

nodes.title: Quote currency from configuration, captured at first send

attrs.statement: Quote currency MUST come from the active FR-026 quote configuration (the FR-029 Default Currency), MUST NOT be provider input, and MUST be captured on the quote at first send so historical prices retain their original currency.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: drafts carry no captured currency; packages carry no currency of their own; currency is displayed read-only.

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to attach quote-level supporting files that apply to every option; file security, access, audit, and retention rules MUST be enforced.
A quote MUST support one or more eligible clinician assignments shared across every option.
Graft description MUST be generated from the approved system template and estimated graft count, displayed read-only, and versioned with the quote.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers MAY enter and revise Estimated Grafts; the system regenerates Graft Description whenever Estimated Grafts changes; providers MUST NOT directly edit it.

nodes.title: System-owned values visible only where authorized

attrs.statement: System-owned identifiers, lifecycle status, price summaries, commission, timestamps, customization state, and version/audit metadata MUST be visible only where authorized and MUST NOT be provider-editable.

nodes.title: Analytics count parent responses, amounts from accepted price

attrs.statement: Quote-amount analytics MUST be computed from the accepted option/date price only. Unaccepted quotes MUST be excluded from amount metrics and counted once as a parent response in volume and conversion metrics; Quote Options MUST NOT be counted as responses.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: analytics MUST distinguish parent quote responses from Quote Options so option counts do not inflate quote-response or conversion metrics.

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at creation and submission

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider status at quote creation and submission and MUST reject quote submission by a `Suspended` or `Deactivated` provider from the effective time, including in-flight requests.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases: a submission at or after the effective time is rejected; no sent quote, patient notification, or version is created.

attrs.statement: When a provider becomes `Suspended` or `Deactivated`, System MUST cancel that provider's unaccepted parent quotes with status `cancelled_provider_status` and `cancellationProvenance` `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated`, once per parent quote rather than per option or option/date alternative, without rewriting the AcceptanceEvent, accepted IDs/versions, or quote-local package snapshots, and without reclassifying terminal or completed history. An accepted parent quote MUST NOT receive `cancelled_provider_status`; it keeps `accepted` and is handled by the FR-006 provider-fault transfer. Processing MUST be deduplicated per provider-status event and quote.

nodes.title: One package seeds one option with prefills

attrs.statement: Each selected package MUST seed exactly one alternative Quote Option (maximum five per parent quote), never summed with another package. The package standard price MUST prefill each applicable option/date-price row, and the package's relative day plan MUST prefill the option plan.

nodes.title: Two package edit paths and option provenance

attrs.statement: Editing a package in the FR-024 package management screen MUST change only the library (as a new package version), and editing inside quote creation MUST change only a quote-local copy that is never written back. Each Quote Option MUST record its source package ID, source package version, and an inline-customised flag.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Package library edits and quote inline edits: the quote-local edit path covers Sub-screen 2A, Tab 5 and Tab 4 prices and never creates a package version; the first inline change sets the option's inline-customised flag.

nodes.title: Promotion terms copied at send; one automatic promotion

attrs.statement: System MUST store the offered price as entered and any promotion discount separately, MUST copy the terms of every attached promotion into the sent quote version at send, and MUST attach at most one automatic FR-019 promotion per quote to each eligible option/date-price row at send, chosen by the FR-019 priority order when several qualify. Later FR-019 promotion edits MUST NOT change a sent quote.

nodes.title: Expiry and currency captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST capture the quote expiry and quote currency read-only at first send from the FR-026 quote configuration. Drafts MUST carry neither, and there MUST be no per-quote expiry extension.

nodes.title: No quote edits or new quotes after acceptance

attrs.statement: After a subquote is accepted, System MUST block every FR-004 quote edit by providers and admins. Treatment-detail changes (plan, clinicians, grafts) MUST go through FR-010. An accepted parent quote MUST never be reopened, expired, or restored to an acceptable state, including after `Payment Window Expired`, and no new parent quote MAY be created or sent for an inquiry with an accepted subquote, except the admin-authored replacement quote of REQ-004-048.

nodes.title: Appointment fields are the FR-006 slot-hold key

attrs.statement: The Quote Option appointment date/time and time zone, together with the provider, MUST be the key FR-006 uses for the slot hold placed at acceptance; FR-004 MUST NOT create an appointment record.
System MUST emit `quote.expiring_soon` once per sent parent quote when it reaches the FR-026 quote-expiring-soon lead time, and MUST NOT emit it for draft, accepted, or terminal quotes.
Every option/date price MUST be greater than 0 before send, and a zero price MUST block send. A date range the clinic cannot serve MUST be left out of that option rather than priced.
attrs.rationale: A zero price is blocked with an inline error on that row.

nodes.title: Default Currency change on a draft

attrs.statement: If the FR-029 Default Currency changes while a draft holds prices, System MUST switch the draft to the new currency, keep every typed number unchanged, and show a "currency changed, check your prices" banner that the provider MUST acknowledge before send.

A sent quote carrying an automatic FR-019 promotion MUST hold exactly one reserved use of that promotion's usage limit. A re-send of a new version MUST keep the existing reservation, create one only if the new version newly qualifies, and release it if the new version no longer carries the promotion. The reservation MUST be released when the quote expires, is withdrawn, or ends not selected or cancelled, MUST be released with reason `not_applied` when the accepted row does not carry the promotion, and MUST be consumed at acceptance when the accepted row carries it, so the usage limit is never exceeded. If the booking later ends in `Payment Window Expired` or is cancelled before the first payment, FR-005 and FR-019 own the return of the consumed use to the limit.
System MUST set the parent quote's `firstSentAt` on its first send, and a re-send or new version MUST NOT change it.

nodes.title: Treatment Base Price is a reference-only prefill

attrs.statement: The FR-024 treatment Base Price MAY prefill a new option/date-price row only where no other standard value exists; it MUST be treated as a non-binding reference and MUST NOT be read after the quote is sent.
FR-004 MUST be the producer of `quote.updated` and MUST emit it when a new version of an already-sent quote is re-sent, described as "quote revised (new version)".

nodes.title: quote.submitted on first send and quote.expired on expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST emit `quote.submitted` on the first send of a parent quote and `quote.expired` when expiry processing moves a sent parent quote to `expired` (FR-030).

nodes.title: FR-004 is the only producer of quote.withdrawn

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST be the only producer of `quote.withdrawn`. The notice MUST go to the patient for every withdrawal and to the admin only when the withdrawn quote was already accepted.
attrs.rationale: A withdrawal before acceptance is a normal provider action; FR-006 reacts to a post-acceptance withdrawal without emitting the event again.

attrs.statement: During an FR-006 provider-fault transfer before treatment starts, System MUST let an admin author a replacement quote for the replacement provider inside the same inquiry through Screen 8, with a mandatory reason and full audit. The quote MUST be marked admin-authored for a replacement and linked to the closed AcceptanceEvent, MUST NOT be offered for patient comparison or emit `quote.submitted`, and MUST be the target of the FR-005 admin-authored replacement acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: it is the only exception to the block on new quotes after acceptance.

nodes.title: Admin edit of a sent quote creates a version

attrs.statement: An admin edit of a sent quote through Screen 7 MUST create a new quote version and MUST emit `quote.updated` when that version is re-sent.

System MUST NOT attach an automatic FR-019 promotion to an admin-authored replacement quote or take a promotion usage reservation for it; the admin sets the replacement price directly. A replacement quote that is not accepted MUST expire under the normal quote expiry, MUST leave the inquiry flagged `supportRequired` without cancelling it automatically, and MUST allow the admin to author another replacement quote or cancel the inquiry and booking.

nodes.title: Inquiry must be active to create or submit

attrs.statement: System MUST verify parent inquiry is not in Cancelled status before accepting quote creation or submission. If inquiry is cancelled mid-draft (race condition), system rejects submission with error "Inquiry no longer active" and locks the draft with "Inquiry Cancelled" banner. Opening quote creation for a cancelled inquiry is blocked with "Inquiry no longer active — this inquiry was cancelled by the patient." and no draft is created; a drafting provider sees the banner "This inquiry was cancelled by the patient. Your draft can no longer be submitted." on next save or refresh, and the draft is retained for reference but cannot be submitted.

nodes.title: Restricted recipient mode for FR-037 conversions

attrs.statement: If the inquiry was created via an FR-037 monitoring-case conversion with an active exclusive provider assignment (REQ-037-029, Business Rule 7; see FR-003 Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B3), only that assigned provider may create quotes for the inquiry, including any additional parent quote. Any other provider attempting to open the inquiry for quote creation is blocked with error "This inquiry is restricted to its assigned provider." The restriction does not change the other workflows (editing, expiry, withdrawal, admin oversight) on quotes that already exist. FR-038 is self-service and does not create an FR-004 inquiry or provider assignment.

nodes.title: Only assigned clinic staff submit or edit

attrs.statement: Only assigned clinic staff may submit/edit quotes for assigned inquiries.
Treatment type selection MUST use admin-curated treatment catalog; no free text.

nodes.title: Grafts, prices and slots present and valid

attrs.statement: Graft/quantity, option/date prices, and scheduled slots MUST be present and valid.

nodes.title: Package active when selected; later changes warn only

attrs.statement: Every Quote Option MUST originate from a package that is active in the authenticated provider's package library when it is selected. If the source package is later edited or deactivated, existing draft and sent options keep their snapshot; a draft may still be submitted, and Tab 7 shows a warning that the source package has changed or is inactive.

nodes.title: What a package seeds and what is entered per quote

attrs.statement: A selected package seeds services and their pricing, included travel services (transport, hotel, flight, and other travel services), the standard price, and the relative day-by-day plan; date ranges, additional notes, and documents are never packaged and are entered per quote.

nodes.title: Treatment first; every option uses it

attrs.statement: Package selection occurs after the shared treatment is selected; every option in the quote MUST use that parent treatment. Tab 2 is unavailable until an active treatment is selected.
Changing the treatment after options exist requires confirmation. The system must identify incompatible options and must not silently retain or discard dependent package, pricing, or plan data.

nodes.title: Library changes never alter existing options

attrs.statement: Package-library changes after snapshot creation MUST NOT alter existing draft or sent options unless the provider explicitly replaces the source package and confirms a new snapshot; replacing the package requires a new snapshot and audit entry.

nodes.title: Each option/date pairing once per option

attrs.statement: Each option/date-range pairing MAY appear only once per option; (quoteOptionId, sourceInquiryDateRangeId) is unique.

nodes.title: Appointment within range, future, with timezone

attrs.statement: The appointment slot must fall within its selected inquiry date range and be in the future when sent; a timezone is required.
Included services, custom services, date applicability/pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day plan belong to the Quote Option or its option/date price record.

A provider may remove an option before submission while at least one valid option remains; removing an option also removes its draft date-price rows and draft treatment plan after explicit confirmation.
Relative day numbers are never resolved to stored calendar dates. Downstream consumers (FR-005 comparison, FR-010 In Progress) present the plan by day number against the accepted appointment.

nodes.title: First send reads the FR-026 quote configuration

attrs.statement: On first send, System records the first-send timestamp, captures the quote expiry and the quote currency read-only from the active FR-026 quote configuration, and records that configuration's version on the quote; drafts carry neither. If the FR-026 configuration cannot be read, first send is blocked and the draft is kept unchanged.

Later edits and re-sends do not reset the quote expiry, later setting changes never affect a sent quote, and there is no per-quote extension. Providers cannot modify the window and only see the computed expiry timestamp.

Expiry applies only to `sent` parent quotes. Upon expiry, system updates the parent quote to `expired`, emits `quote.expired` once for that parent quote (FR-030), and every child subquote becomes ineligible for acceptance. `accepted` quotes and every cancelled, withdrawn, or archived quote are never moved to `expired`.
attrs.rationale: A quote accepted shortly before its expiry stays `accepted` during the payment hold.

attrs.statement: Saving draft edits without re-sending emits nothing.

nodes.title: Provider withdraws or archives before acceptance

attrs.statement: Provider may withdraw or archive quotes pre-acceptance.

An accepted parent quote stays `accepted` and is never reopened for acceptance or moved to `expired`, including after FR-006 moves the booking to `Payment Window Expired`; its status changes only through provider withdrawal (Workflow 6). An admin booking cancellation in FR-006 moves the booking and inquiry to `Cancelled` but leaves the accepted parent quote `accepted`. Competing parent quotes stay cancelled.
The patient's inquiry cancellation reason is patient-private and NOT shared with providers.

nodes.title: Draft cancelled by provider status is silent to the patient

attrs.statement: Cancelling an unsent draft because of provider suspension or deactivation is silent to the patient: the patient never saw it, so it triggers no `provider.status_cancellation_patient` notice on its own (admin support alerts still follow FR-020).

nodes.title: Reactivation does not restore cancelled quotes

attrs.statement: Later reactivation of the provider does not restore quotes cancelled with `cancelled_provider_status`; other providers' quotes are unaffected by the cascade; quotes already expired, withdrawn, archived, or otherwise terminal are not reclassified.

nodes.title: Patient sees provider-status cancellation as unavailable

attrs.statement: Patients see a quote cancelled by provider status as unavailable ("Offer Unavailable") with a Contact Admin/Support action rather than the patient-cancellation message.

Provider may soft-delete a quote before acceptance (removes from provider listing, not from audit/archive or patient record); the system sets status = Archived with rationale. Quotes in terminal states (accepted, expired, withdrawn, cancelled_other_accepted, cancelled_inquiry_cancelled, cancelled_provider_status) cannot be soft-deleted by provider.

Soft-deletes are fully auditable and revertible only by admin. Admin can perform soft delete or restore and view the immutable audit trail and full quote history; soft delete and restore are unavailable for a quote in `accepted` status, which is never deleted or restored. Only admin can restore expired/archived quotes if justified (GDPR-compliant log); restore to an acceptable state is blocked when the inquiry already has an accepted subquote.

nodes.title: Admin authors a quote only as a replacement

attrs.statement: Admin authors a quote only as the replacement quote of an FR-006 provider-fault transfer (Workflow 7, Screen 8).

nodes.title: Withdrawal after acceptance needs a reason and edits nothing

attrs.statement: Provider submits a withdrawal after acceptance with a mandatory reason; the parent quote moves from `accepted` to `withdrawn`. This is the only status change FR-004 makes after acceptance; no quote field, option, or option/date-price record is edited.

nodes.title: Replacement quote only before treatment starts

attrs.statement: The provider-fault transfer with a replacement quote and a new acceptance applies only before treatment starts (booking `Accepted` or `Confirmed`); provider drop-out after acceptance, including an FR-010 reassignment, is not a quote withdrawal. If the fault happens in Aftercare, no replacement quote, new acceptance, or new payment is created. Screen 8 is unavailable for a booking in `In Progress` or later stages and for any inquiry with an active acceptance.

Before the admin authors a replacement quote, the system checks that the booking was closed with a provider-fault cause (`ProviderFault`, `ProviderSuspended`, or `ProviderDeactivated`), that the inquiry has no active acceptance, that treatment had not started, and that the replacement provider is `Active` and is not the provider at fault.

nodes.title: Replacement quote captures currency and expiry when saved for acceptance

attrs.statement: A replacement quote captures its currency from the active FR-026 quote configuration, and its expiry is captured from the active FR-026 quote configuration when it is saved for acceptance.

nodes.title: Authoring a replacement quote sends no notice

attrs.statement: Authoring a replacement quote sends no notice.

After acceptance, price, currency, date range, and promotion never change; the booking's appointment changes only through the FR-006 admin appointment change, which emits `booking.rescheduled`, while the acceptance snapshot keeps the accepted appointment as the baseline.

nodes.title: Edits only while draft or sent

attrs.statement: Providers and admins may edit a quote only while it is `draft` or `sent`. Edits on accepted, expired, withdrawn, archived, or cancelled quotes are prohibited, and a late edit or deletion is disallowed with a user message.

nodes.title: Acceptance values are read-only copies of the FR-005 snapshot

attrs.statement: `acceptedTotal`, `termsAcknowledgedAt`, and `lockedExchangeRateSnapshot` are read-only copies written at FR-005 acceptance from the acceptance snapshot; the FR-005 snapshot is authoritative, and downstream FRs read money fields from it. Acceptance state is not stored on the option/date-price record; it is derived from FR-005.

nodes.title: confirmed is not a quote status

attrs.statement: `confirmed` is a booking status owned by FR-006, never a quote status; an accepted quote stays `accepted`.

The quote shows the commission model and value (percentage or flat rate) only as an indicative figure labelled "indicative, final at booking confirmation"; the binding commission is fixed at booking confirmation on the accepted price after promotion, in the quote currency, read from the acceptance snapshot (FR-029).

nodes.title: Automatic promotion with no uses left is not attached

attrs.statement: An automatic promotion with no uses left is not eligible and is not attached; when its last use is reserved by another quote before this quote is sent, it is not attached at send, because the usage limit can never be exceeded.
Discounts are provider-managed (reviewed by admin if above configured threshold).
All notifications MUST comply with platform notification/audit/logging rules.

nodes.title: Quote objects retained for at least 7 years

attrs.statement: GDPR/data compliance: all quote objects are archived for at least 7 years.

nodes.title: Price range derived from option/date prices

attrs.statement: The quote price range is derived from all option/date prices, from the lowest to the highest option/date price, and is never entered separately.
System retains an abandoned draft for 7 days, then auto-archives it.

nodes.title: Patient accepts one subquote; no parent-level action

attrs.statement: The patient accepts exactly one subquote through FR-005; there is no parent-level Accept or Decline action. If the patient accepts no subquote, all open sent quotes expire automatically.

nodes.title: Draft locked when another quote is accepted

attrs.statement: While a provider is drafting a quote, if another quote is accepted, the unsent draft is cancelled silently as "cancelled (other accepted)" with no notice; on next open the draft is read-only with the "Another Quote Accepted" badge and cannot be submitted.

nodes.title: Drafts and archived quotes hidden from patients

attrs.statement: Drafts and archived quotes are never shown to patients.

nodes.title: Cancelled quotes are read-only with badge and banner

attrs.statement: Quotes with status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)" are displayed with greyed-out row styling and an "Inquiry Cancelled" badge, show a prominent "Inquiry Cancelled" banner on the detail view, have all edit and delete actions disabled, and remain read-only for reference; an edit attempt is blocked with the message "This quote was cancelled because the patient cancelled their inquiry". Quotes with status "cancelled (other accepted)" are similarly greyed out with an "Another Quote Accepted" badge.

nodes.title: Admin promotion change on a draft or sent quote

attrs.statement: Admin may add, replace, or remove the structured promotion on an option/date price of a draft or sent quote; inline create is permitted with `scope = AD_HOC_QUOTE_BOUND` per FR-019 Screen 9 Mode 2. The promotion must resolve to a valid PromotionProgram id or null, a reason is required, and the change creates a new quote version into which the current promotion terms are copied.
A promotion on an option/date price must resolve to a valid structured `PromotionProgram`; no free-text promotion.

nodes.title: Admin grafts change regenerates description without keeping prior text

attrs.statement: When an admin saves a new Estimated Grafts value through Screen 7, Graft Description is regenerated from the approved template; the prior text is not preserved.

nodes.title: Every parent quote shown; each subquote a complete selectable choice

attrs.statement: System MUST show every parent quote received for an inquiry, including multiple parent quotes from the same provider, and MUST expose each child subquote as a complete patient-selectable commercial choice.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 1-2 and the Patient Platform scope: the patient views parent quotes grouped by provider and quote response within the Inquiry Dashboard, and each subquote presents its package, date range, appointment details, pricing, and inherited parent information as one complete choice.

nodes.title: Exactly one subquote acceptance per inquiry; no parent acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the patient to accept exactly one valid subquote per inquiry and MUST NOT allow direct acceptance of a parent quote or any upper-level inherited record.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (a parent quote cannot be accepted directly; subsequent attempts are blocked with guidance, including after Payment Window Expired), Alternative Flow A2 (a second acceptance is prevented with guidance referencing the accepted subquote), the Screen 1 business rules (parent quotes are grouping and inheritance boundaries, not patient-selectable acceptance items; a subquote is the lowest-level complete commercial choice and the only selectable acceptance item; exactly one subquote acceptance is permitted per inquiry), the Communication Structure (Patient to System: accept action on one eligible subquote), the fixed-in-codebase subquote acceptance uniqueness constraint, Screen 4 (exactly one Accepted across the inquiry), the edge case on simultaneous accept attempts across devices (first valid acceptance wins; others see an informative message), and the implementation note that concurrency control prevents races across subquotes of the same inquiry.

nodes.title: Siblings Not Selected and competing parent quotes auto-cancelled

attrs.statement: On acceptance, System MUST mark sibling subquotes in the accepted parent quote Not Selected and MUST auto-cancel all competing parent quotes for the same inquiry with reasons and notifications.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Provider Platform scope (competing parent quotes auto-cancelled with reason "Other subquote accepted"; sibling subquotes in the accepted parent quote become "Not Selected"), Business Rule 2 (a valid acceptance atomically acquires the slot hold, locks the subquote and its inherited parent context, marks siblings Not Selected and auto-cancels competing parent quotes with clear reasons and notifications; if the slot is already held or blocked, the attempt fails before any of those state changes), and Main Flow step 8.

attrs.statement: System MUST block subquote acceptance when the subquote or its parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, archived, superseded, or stale, with clear messaging.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5 (a subquote is ineligible if it or its parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, archived, superseded, or no longer the version presented to the patient, or if its owning provider is Suspended or Deactivated under FR-015), the Entry Points (acceptance is available only while the target subquote and its parent quote are eligible), Screen 1 (expired or withdrawn parent quotes make all child subquotes ineligible; terminal child subquotes are visually disabled), Screen 2 (Accept is disabled if the subquote or parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, superseded, or stale, or another subquote is already accepted), and Alternative Flow A3 with its edge case (a parent quote withdrawn just before confirmation blocks acceptance with explanation, and the patient returns to the inquiry dashboard to select another eligible subquote).

nodes.title: Booking/payment handoff prepared without collecting funds

attrs.statement: System MUST prepare the booking/payment handoff from the accepted subquote without collecting funds in this module.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing (acceptance prepares the booking/payment handoff; no funds are collected in this module), Main Flow step 10, the Patient Platform scope (after acceptance, proceed to the booking/payment entry point), and the Out of Scope list (payment collection and invoice issuance are handled in Booking & Payment).

nodes.title: Immutable acceptance snapshot with binding fields

attrs.statement: System MUST preserve an immutable acceptance snapshot containing the accepted subquote identifier/version, the underlying Quote Option ID and Option/date-price ID, the source package ID/version, the parent quote identifier/version and expiry, provider and inquiry references, treatment ID/version, package and service snapshot, date range, appointment date/time/timezone, offered price, any patient-applied promotion code and the resulting discounted price, promotion, currency, exchange rate and its timestamp, treatment plan, estimated grafts, graft description, visual plan, clinician IDs, notes, requirements, attachment IDs with versions, actor, and timestamp; `acceptedSubquoteVersion` MUST equal `acceptedParentQuoteVersion` because both identify the same FR-004 aggregate revision; all resulting state changes MUST be audited. Price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion are the binding fields that downstream modules MUST read from the snapshot; the snapshot appointment is the accepted baseline, and booking notices MUST read the booking's current appointment, which only an FR-006 admin appointment change can alter. The treatment details are the original record at acceptance; later changes to plan, clinicians, or grafts are made only through FR-010 with audit and patient notice, and never edit the snapshot.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing binding snapshot fields (price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion are read from the snapshot by every downstream module and the snapshot never changes after acceptance; an admin may later change the booking's appointment through FR-006, which emits booking.rescheduled, and every booking notice reads the booking's current appointment; after acceptance only the clinic or an admin may change the plan, clinicians, or grafts, through FR-010 only, with audit and patient notice, and the snapshot itself is never edited), Payment & Billing pricing (the resulting price and promotion are frozen into the snapshot; only the provider-fault transfer creates a new linked record), and Key Entities (acceptedSubquoteVersion MUST equal acceptedParentQuoteVersion; acceptanceSnapshot preserves the complete subquote plus inherited parent context, including the exchange rate and its timestamp and any patient-applied promotion code).

nodes.title: Acceptance records retained for at least 7 years

attrs.statement: System MUST retain acceptance and related parent quote/subquote records for ≥ 7 years.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rule 4 (acceptance and related quote/subquote records retained at least 7 years).

nodes.title: Patient identity masked to providers until payment confirmation

attrs.statement: System MUST keep patient identity masked to providers until payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 3 (acceptance does not reveal patient full identity; full PII becomes accessible only after successful payment confirmation, per constitution), Data & Privacy Rule 1, the Provider Platform scope, the fixed-in-codebase patient identity reveal policy, the Out of Scope list, the business process assumption, and the security note (no PII reveal on acceptance).

nodes.title: Encryption at rest and in transit; RBAC for actions

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt data at rest and in transit and enforce RBAC for actions.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rule 2 (all data in transit and at rest is protected according to platform policies) and the security note (RBAC for all actors; encryption at rest and in transit).

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-004 for parent quote, Quote Option, option/date-price, lifecycle, aggregate `QuoteVersion`, and audit contracts and with FR-020 for notifications.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the integration-points note: FR-005 consumes parent quote and subquote data from FR-004, updates inquiry, parent quote, and subquote states, and triggers the notification service.

nodes.title: Booking handoff built from the accepted subquote

attrs.statement: System MUST emit a booking handoff whose atomic commercial input is the accepted subquote and whose inherited context is resolved from its parent quote.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing (the accepted subquote is the complete handoff unit; it carries the selected package, date range, appointment date/time/timezone, offered price, promotion when applicable, and references to the inherited parent quote, provider, and treatment context), Main Flow step 10, and the Entry Points (upon acceptance the system locks the selection, resolves sibling and competing outcomes, and triggers booking handoff).

nodes.title: Filter and sort subquotes on subquote and inherited criteria

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to filter and sort subquotes using both subquote-owned and inherited comparison criteria.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen 1 business rules (patient can sort/filter subquotes). The sort and filter options are REQ-005-053.

nodes.title: Side-by-side comparison of up to three subquotes

attrs.statement: System MUST support side-by-side comparison of up to three subquotes, regardless of whether they belong to the same or different parent quotes/providers.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 3, the Screen 1 business rules (compare up to three side-by-side, including siblings under one parent quote or subquotes from different parent quotes/providers), and the Compare Selection field (maximum three eligible subquotes, regardless of parent quote or provider grouping).

attrs.statement: System MUST display these subquote comparison differentiators: package, included/custom services, date range, appointment details, total price, currency, promotion, price per graft, treatment plan, inherited graft count, provider review rating/count, and provider credentials summary. Estimated travel costs remain deferred pending an approved FR-008 source.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen 1 Comparison Differentiators field, which lists the same rows.

nodes.title: Quote questions through FR-012 Messages/Inbox; no embedded chat

attrs.statement: Patients MUST be able to ask providers questions about quotes through the dedicated FR-012 Messages/Inbox; quote screens MAY navigate to the existing provider conversation but MUST NOT embed a chat surface.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Communication Structure (Patient to Provider questions through the dedicated FR-012 Messages/Inbox conversation; direct patient-provider chat is out of scope) and the Screen 1 Message Provider button (opens that provider's conversation in FR-012; does not embed chat in the quote screen).

nodes.title: Provider notified of quote questions within 5 minutes

attrs.statement: System MUST notify the provider of patient quote questions within 5 minutes.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Communication Structure (System to Provider: notify the provider of patient quote questions within 5 minutes).

attrs.statement: System MUST lock quote exchange rate at time of patient acceptance (per FR-004 pricing rules) and MUST record the rate and its timestamp in the acceptance snapshot. When the cached rate is older than 24 hours, acceptance MUST proceed on the cached rate and record it with its timestamp, without adding a review state.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing (the exchange rate is locked at acceptance per FR-004 and the System PRD pricing rules; when the cached rate is older than 24 hours acceptance proceeds on it and records its timestamp; no review state is added, and operations may review afterwards).

nodes.title: Subquote resolves one Quote Option and one Option/date-price

attrs.statement: A subquote MUST resolve exactly one FR-004 Quote Option and one applicable Option/date-price record into one complete package, date range, appointment, and offered-price selection. It MUST inherit shared provider, treatment, graft, visual-plan, clinician, note, requirement, attachment, currency, expiry, and audit context from exactly one parent quote. FR-005 owns the subquote identifier and state: the identifier is derived deterministically from the Quote Option ID and Option/date-price ID, so it stays the same across parent re-versions while both records exist. A parent quote offers up to (number of Quote Options × number of date ranges) subquotes, because a provider may leave out pairings it cannot offer.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary (the subquote is the atomic patient comparison and acceptance unit; one Quote Option package snapshot together with exactly one Option/date-price record; neither is accepted independently), Screen 1 (a parent quote offers up to Quote Options x date ranges subquotes and every Quote Option has at least one date range; a selectable subquote has exactly one date range, and its appointment must fall within that range), and Key Entities (FR-005 owns id and state; id is derived deterministically from quoteOptionId and optionDatePriceId).

nodes.title: Confirmation validates the current parent QuoteVersion

attrs.statement: Acceptance confirmation MUST validate the current parent aggregate `QuoteVersion`, MUST require the derived `subquoteVersion` to equal it, and MUST reject stale selections before creating an AcceptanceEvent.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary and Key Entities (subquoteVersion is the owning parent quote's QuoteVersion, not a separate revision counter), Main Flow step 6, Screen 2 (confirmation rejects a stale version; the accepted subquote and inherited context lock on acceptance), Screen 3 (the summary must reflect the latest subquote and parent versions), the implementation note on version validation before locking the snapshot, and the edge case where the provider edits the parent quote or selected subquote after the patient opens confirmation (the stale confirmation is rejected and the current version must be reviewed).

nodes.title: Parent quote and subquote analytics remain distinct

attrs.statement: Parent quote and subquote analytics MUST remain distinct: one provider response counts once at parent level (metric: Parent Quote Responses), while comparison and selection behavior is recorded at subquote level (metrics: Subquote Comparisons and Subquote Selections).

nodes.title: Acceptance atomically acquires an exclusive slot hold

attrs.statement: Acceptance MUST atomically acquire an exclusive hold on the selected appointment slot and MUST reject a second acceptance for a slot already held or blocked by another pending or confirmed booking, including a concurrent acceptance that finds an active hold already exists, before creating an AcceptanceEvent, changing quote/inquiry states, or emitting a booking handoff. The rejected patient MUST be told the slot was just taken.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 2, Main Flow step 6 (one fixed, exclusive slot hold keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone; if another pending or confirmed booking holds or blocks the slot, acceptance is rejected before an AcceptanceEvent or booking handoff is created), Alternative Flow A5 and Screen 3 (error state "This appointment slot was just taken. Please choose another subquote."; no acceptance is recorded; the patient returns to the inquiry dashboard; the existing reservation is unchanged), and Payment & Billing post-acceptance hold (acceptance and exclusive slot reservation are one atomic operation; a second acceptance targeting the held or blocked slot is rejected).

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate the owning provider's status at acceptance and MUST block acceptance of any subquote whose provider is `Suspended` or `Deactivated` from the effective time, including in-flight confirmations. For a still-comparing inquiry, System MUST keep other providers' subquotes acceptable. When the status takes effect after acceptance, System MUST release any active hold, retain the AcceptanceEvent and acceptance snapshot without rewriting, record cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` with `supportRequired` on the FR-006 booking and the FR-003 ProviderInquiry (the supersession record is written only when the replacement acceptance is recorded), route the case to the FR-006 provider-fault transfer within the same inquiry, and tell the patient that an admin will arrange a replacement provider instead of showing the patient-cancellation message.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 8 (cause ProviderSuspended or ProviderDeactivated with an independent supportRequired marker; distinct from patient inquiry cancellation and Payment Window Expired; does not reclassify Completed or already-terminal history), Alternative Flow A6 (from the effective time Accept is blocked and an in-flight confirmation is rejected before an AcceptanceEvent or hold is created; FR-004 cancels that provider's parent quotes once each, while other providers' subquotes stay acceptable and the inquiry keeps its stage with supportRequired = true), Payment & Billing provider status change during hold (the hold is released even if time remains; the acceptance snapshot and locked price/exchange rate are retained unchanged), and the edge case of a status change while the patient is on the confirmation modal.

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT allow an AcceptanceEvent, accepted subquote, or its parent quote to be deleted, restored, or edited. Admins MAY add audited notes or corrections as annotations next to an AcceptanceEvent; an annotation MUST NOT change the event, its snapshot, or any quote, subquote, or inquiry state.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope, Admin Editability (an annotation never alters the AcceptanceEvent, its snapshot, the accepted IDs/versions, or any quote, subquote, or inquiry state; AcceptanceEvent immutability is fixed in codebase), Business Rule 6 (AcceptanceEvents, accepted subquotes, and their parent quotes are never deleted or restored; admins may only add audited annotations next to them), Screen 5 (annotations are append-only, each showing author, time, and reason; no delete or restore action exists), and Key Entities (AcceptanceAnnotation is an audited, append-only admin note).

nodes.title: Only additional acceptance is the provider-fault replacement

attrs.statement: System MUST allow exactly one patient acceptance per inquiry. The only additional acceptance record is the admin-authored record created by an FR-006 provider-fault transfer before treatment starts; it MUST point to an admin-authored FR-004 replacement quote, Quote Option, and option/date-price row, and the original MUST be marked superseded by one supersession record inserted at the replacement acceptance rather than by editing it.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (applies only before treatment starts; the closure is recorded on the booking as its cause; one supersession record with cause ProviderFault, ProviderSuspended, or ProviderDeactivated links the closed acceptance to the new one; the patient keeps the same inquiry and re-enters nothing; money already paid moves with the patient as credit toward the replacement booking, any unused part refunded, with no cancellation fee, the mechanics being defined by FR-007, FR-007b, and FR-017), Alternative Flows A3, A6, and A9 (FR-006 owns the provider-fault case; the admin authors the replacement quote on FR-004 Screen 8 and records a new AcceptanceEvent with actorType = admin; the AcceptanceSupersession record is inserted once and never updated; the original AcceptanceEvent and snapshot stay unchanged as history), Admin Editability, and Key Entities (AcceptanceSupersession).

nodes.title: One fixed slot hold for the FR-026 duration

attrs.statement: Acceptance MUST place one fixed slot hold keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone for the FR-026 slot-hold duration, starting at acceptance. Payment failure MUST NOT extend the hold, and the appointment record MUST be created by FR-006 only on successful first payment. After `Payment Window Expired`, the accepted subquote MUST NOT be reopened; the patient's recovery route is "Contact support", through which an admin performs the FR-006 revive or an FR-006 booking cancellation.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 6-7 (default 48 hours; no appointment record is created at acceptance), Alternative Flow A7 (the hold is released; the accepted subquote is never reopened, siblings stay Not Selected, competing parent quotes stay cancelled, and the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot stay unchanged; a revive is performed by FR-006 with a fresh slot-availability check and a new hold, and FR-005 creates no second acceptance; missed later instalments never cause Payment Window Expired), and Payment & Billing post-acceptance hold (payment failures or retries never extend the hold).

nodes.title: Patient promotion code on one named subquote before acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST let the patient apply a promotion code to one named subquote before acceptance, validated through FR-019, and MUST freeze the discounted price and promotion into the acceptance snapshot. The code MUST NOT be written to the provider's quote or promotion records, and the price and promotion MUST NOT change after acceptance except through an FR-006 provider-fault transfer.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A8 (the discounted price is shown next to the offered price and carried into the confirmation summary; an invalid code shows the reason and leaves the offered price unchanged; the code does not carry over to another subquote; after acceptance the promotion and price cannot be removed, replaced, re-entered at checkout, or changed by revalidation, including an admin void), the Screen 2 Promotion Code field and business rule (not available after acceptance), and Payment & Billing pricing.

nodes.title: Price sort converts to display currency for ordering only

attrs.statement: When sorting subquotes by price, System MUST convert each price to the patient's display currency at the current rate for ordering only, MUST keep showing each subquote in its own quote currency, and MUST label the price order approximate when the listed subquotes use more than one currency.

nodes.title: Auto-applied promotion use consumed or released at acceptance

attrs.statement: On acceptance, System MUST consume the auto-applied promotion use reserved at send for the accepted parent quote and MUST release the reservations of every parent quote that ends Not Selected or auto-cancelled, as defined by FR-019. When the accepted subquote does not carry the automatic promotion reserved for its parent quote, System MUST release that reservation with reason `not_applied`.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 8 and Payment & Billing auto-applied promotion use (a sent parent quote holds at most one reserved use; re-sending keeps it, creates one only if the new version newly carries the promotion, and releases it if not; Payment Window Expired or cancellation before the first payment returns the consumed use to the limit; provider-selected promotions and patient-entered codes reserve at acceptance and consume at first payment; usage limits count reservations plus consumed uses). The reservation lifecycle itself is defined by FR-019.

nodes.title: booking.scheduled to the patient; quote.accepted to providers

attrs.statement: At acceptance, System MUST send the patient only `booking.scheduled` ("Booking Accepted — Slot Held (Pending Payment)"); `quote.accepted` outcome notices MUST go to providers only. `booking.scheduled` MUST go to the patient only, MUST be mandatory (not disableable), and MUST also fire on an admin-authored replacement acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 9 and Alternative Flow A9 (at the replacement acceptance the patient receives the mandatory booking.scheduled notice and the replacement provider receives quote.accepted).

nodes.title: No patient inquiry cancel after acceptance; Contact support

attrs.statement: After acceptance, System MUST NOT offer the patient an inquiry cancel action and MUST show "Contact support" instead; booking cancellation from acceptance onward is performed only by an admin through FR-006.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flows A4 and A7 (after acceptance the patient sees "Contact support"; an admin booking cancellation through FR-006 moves the booking and the inquiry to Cancelled, releases any active slot hold immediately, and leaves the accepted subquote and its parent quote accepted; refunds and fees follow the FR-006 payment placeholder), Admin Editability (cancel a booking after acceptance, from any booking state, through FR-006 with a mandatory reason and audit), Payment & Billing cancellation during hold, and the edge case of a patient who wants to cancel immediately after accepting.

attrs.statement: Patient accesses quote comparison from the Inquiry Dashboard (FR-003 Screen 8), where quotes are displayed within the inquiry context, or via push/email notification.
Providers have read-only visibility of the accepted or non-selected outcome for their parent quotes and subquotes; the provider platform is read-only in this module.

nodes.title: Flagged acceptance races investigated; first valid acceptance stands

attrs.statement: Flagged acceptance races or errors are investigated by an admin: the first valid acceptance stands, and the admin records findings as an annotation.
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Admin Platform scope, Admin Editability, and the Screen 5 Conflicts field.

attrs.statement: All acceptance-related state transitions are immutably audited (who, when, what, reason). Audit logs must record the accepted subquote, inherited parent snapshot, actor, presented versions, and every affected parent quote and sibling subquote.
attrs.rationale: Stated by Business Rule 4 and Data & Privacy Rule 3; restated by Main Flow step 11, the Shared Services scope, and the implementation note (append-only audit trail covering acceptance, sibling Not Selected outcomes, and competing parent quote cancellations).

attrs.statement: The terms acknowledgment checkbox must be checked before the Accept button is enabled; the patient confirms the exact subquote with terms acknowledgment and a complete selection summary, and the confirmation modal requires the acknowledgment if it is not already checked.
attrs.rationale: Stated in Main Flow step 5, the Screen 2 Terms Acknowledgment field and business rule, and the Screen 3 Terms Acknowledgment field.

attrs.statement: System checks inquiry status at confirmation; if the inquiry has been cancelled, acceptance is blocked with the message "This inquiry has been cancelled."
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 6 revalidates the inquiry atomically at confirmation; the edge case covers an inquiry cancellation being processed while the patient accepts.

nodes.title: Acceptance sets parent quote and inquiry to Accepted and writes the accepted total

attrs.statement: After the exclusive hold succeeds, System records the selected subquote as Accepted, locks its inherited parent context and commercial details, sets the parent quote and inquiry to Accepted, records the acceptance snapshot (including the exchange rate and its timestamp) and the slot-hold reference, and writes the accepted subquote price as the parent quote's accepted total (FR-004 acceptedTotal), read from the snapshot. No appointment record is created at acceptance; FR-006 creates it only on successful first payment.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 7 and the Main Flow outcome (inquiry transitions to Accepted; one subquote and its inherited parent context are locked as the accepted selection).

nodes.title: One outcome notice per sent parent quote; no quote.declined

attrs.statement: Each provider receives one notice per sent parent quote (selected or not selected); an unsent draft quote cancelled by FR-004 because another quote was accepted produces no notice. No quote.declined event is emitted for these outcomes.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 9; delivery is through FR-020.

nodes.title: Non-selected notices reveal no winner or price

attrs.statement: Notifications sent to non-selected providers (due to auto-cancellation) MUST NOT reveal the identity of the selected provider or the accepted price. The non-selected reason reads "Other subquote accepted" or "Inquiry cancelled by patient".
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 7, Main Flow step 9, and the Screen 4 Reason field (must not identify another provider or disclose the accepted price).

attrs.statement: When the parent quote countdown reaches zero while the patient is viewing details, System disables the Accept button and shows an "Expired" badge with guidance to choose another quote; every subquote under that parent quote becomes ineligible. The expiry timer applies to every child subquote and shows a static "Expired on [date]" when expired. If no eligible subquote remains, the patient may cancel the inquiry and submit a new one, or contact support.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1, the Screen 1 Expiry Timer field, and the Patient Platform scope (the patient sees the parent quote expiry countdown).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiry makes the dashboard read-only

attrs.statement: If the inquiry stage is "Cancelled", all Accept buttons and Compare checkboxes are disabled and the dashboard is read-only with a "Cancelled" badge; quote data remains visible for reference. If the patient cancels the inquiry while on the acceptance confirmation modal, the modal is dismissed and the inquiry dashboard refreshes to show the "Cancelled" badge with all actions disabled.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules, Alternative Flow A4 (the cancellation itself and the quote cascade belong to FR-003 Workflow 5 and FR-004; the patient can create a new inquiry immediately), and the confirmation-modal edge case.

nodes.title: Admin booking cancellation keeps the acceptance; no supersession record

attrs.statement: If an admin cancels the booking after acceptance, the AcceptanceEvent is retained unchanged and no AcceptanceSupersession record is written; the accepted subquote and parent Quote stay accepted.
attrs.rationale: Key Entities (AcceptanceEvent and AcceptanceSupersession), Alternative Flow A4, Payment & Billing cancellation during hold, and the Screen 5 Supersession Indicator (no supersession record exists for a cancellation). The edge case on a patient who wants to cancel immediately after accepting says the cancellation writes a linked supersession record; that conflict is flagged for the product owner.

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, when Accept is blocked because the provider became Suspended or Deactivated, the patient sees the inline error "This provider is no longer available. Please contact support." with a Contact Admin/Support action, not the patient-cancellation messaging. After acceptance, when the deposit or booking-confirming payment is blocked for the same reason, the patient sees the inline error "This clinic can no longer perform your treatment. An admin will arrange a replacement clinic within the same inquiry." and is not asked to start a new inquiry or re-enter anything. Both are on-screen errors shown in the app, not FR-020 notifications, and are localized through FR-021 like other UI text.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 outcome and the confirmation-modal edge case. The FR-020 patient notices for the same events are separate and owned elsewhere.

nodes.title: Replayed cascades and late requests never revive or duplicate

attrs.statement: A replayed provider-status cascade or a stale acceptance request arriving afterward creates no duplicate cancellation, notification, AcceptanceEvent, or hold. Late acceptance requests or payment callbacks cannot revive the original selection, and later reactivation does not restore it.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 outcome and the provider-status edge case.

attrs.statement: If no replacement acceptance is recorded, the replacement quote expires under the normal FR-004 quote expiry and no AcceptanceEvent or AcceptanceSupersession record is written. The inquiry stays flagged supportRequired and is not cancelled automatically.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A9. The admin's follow-up actions (another replacement quote on FR-004 Screen 8, or cancelling the inquiry and booking on the FR-006 admin screen) belong to FR-004 and FR-006.

nodes.title: No replacement acceptance once treatment has started

attrs.statement: If the provider fault happens while the booking is In Progress, or in Aftercare after treatment is done, no replacement acceptance is created.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A9 boundary and Business Rule 1 (the provider-fault transfer applies only before treatment starts). The admin's In Progress and Aftercare actions (move to Aftercare with reassignment, cancel, or reassign the aftercare provider or team) belong to FR-006.

nodes.title: Comparison panel needs at least two selected subquotes

attrs.statement: The comparison panel renders only when at least two subquotes are selected.
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Screen 1 list and comparison panel heading and the Comparison View field.

nodes.title: Comparison panel follows the current parent version

attrs.statement: The comparison panel always shows the current parent quote version. If the provider re-versions a parent quote, the panel refreshes to the current version; if a compared subquote no longer exists or becomes ineligible, it drops out of the panel and the patient is told why.

nodes.title: Accept available from the dashboard and the detail

attrs.statement: Patient can view subquote details and accept an eligible subquote directly from the dashboard; Accept is enabled only for a current eligible subquote.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and the per-subquote Actions field (View Details and Accept).

attrs.statement: Each subquote shows the offered price as entered by the provider, before any promotion (FR-004), with the price after promotion shown next to it when a promotion applies; a structured promotion attached to the subquote shows its discount separately from the offered price, with its terms when present. Prices use the parent quote currency snapshot and cannot be edited by the patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 per-subquote Price and Promotion fields.

attrs.statement: Price per graft is the subquote price divided by the inherited graft count; it is calculated and non-editable.
Subquote state is Available, Accepted, Not Selected, Expired, Withdrawn, or Cancelled, derived from the parent and subquote lifecycle; exactly one subquote across the inquiry is Accepted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 per-subquote State field and Screen 4 Subquote Outcome field.

nodes.title: Sort and filter options and default

attrs.statement: Sort options are Price (Low–High), Price (High–Low), Graft Count, Rating, Appointment Date, and Quote Date; subquotes can be filtered by patient-submitted date range; the default sort is Quote Date (most recent). Criteria evaluate the complete subquote plus inherited parent and provider values.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Sort & Filter field; the currency handling for price sorting is REQ-005-027.

attrs.statement: All relevant parent quote and subquote details from FR-004 Screen 4 are displayed read-only on the subquote detail, which reflects the latest provider edits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules and the Inherited Parent Context field.

attrs.statement: Tapping Accept on a subquote detail screen opens the confirmation modal with the complete subquote summary, inherited context, and next steps.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 and Screen 3 business rules; Main Flow step 4.

attrs.statement: Confirmation is idempotent: duplicate confirmations do nothing, and repeat requests keyed to the inquiry and accepted subquote do not create multiple accepted states; after a network loss during acceptance the system retries safely with no duplicate accept states.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules, the network-loss edge case, and the implementation note on idempotent acceptance.

attrs.statement: After confirmation the modal closes and the patient is directed to the booking/payment entry; the patient can cancel to return to the quote detail screen.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and the Confirm and Cancel actions (Cancel is always available).

nodes.title: Selected provider sees the accepted terms from the snapshot

attrs.statement: The selected provider sees the package, date range, appointment details, price, currency, and promotion accepted from it, read from the acceptance snapshot; this is shown only to the selected provider and is read-only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Selected Subquote field.

nodes.title: Oversight status derived from booking cancellation and supersession

attrs.statement: Admin oversight status is active, booking cancelled (derived from the FR-006 booking cancellation, with no supersession record), or superseded (provider fault, including provider suspension or deactivation, derived from linked supersession records). "Superseded — Provider Fault" links to the replacement admin-authored acceptance record; "Booking Cancelled" is read from the FR-006 booking cancellation and links to its audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Global Acceptance Table and Supersession Indicator fields.

attrs.statement: All deletes are soft deletes; no hard deletes are permitted.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 6, the fixed-in-codebase soft delete policy, and the Shared Services retention/archival utilities.

nodes.title: Confirmation copy content-managed; legal text central

attrs.statement: Acceptance confirmation copy and UX notes are content-managed; legal text and terms acknowledgment text are controlled centrally (A-09 system settings).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (configurable with restrictions), the A-09 dependency, and the business process assumption.

nodes.title: Acceptance binds the exact appointment and price

attrs.statement: Patient acceptance of the subquote constitutes acceptance of its exact appointment and price. FR-006 must not ask the patient to select another package, date range, appointment, or quote price.
Patients do not have an explicit "decline" action; sibling subquotes become Not Selected and competing parent quotes auto-cancel on acceptance or expire by policy.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from the user behavior assumptions because it is a business rule.

attrs.statement: When an admin finds a quote or subquote was cancelled by mistake, no restore action exists: the admin records the finding as an audited annotation, prior acceptance is not overridden, and the patient uses the recovery routes in Alternative Flows A1 and A7.

Each tab has a completion gate; Review & Submit links each issue back to its owning tab and submits parent and options as one transaction.

Provider views all quotes in a single unified list with no tabs, reflecting global case statuses; actions (Edit, Soft Delete, View Details) are state-aware; cancelled quotes are greyed out with a badge and all actions disabled.

Provider inspects full quote details, patient-first as a continuation of the inquiry (Patient, Inquiry, Quote, Audit); Edit and Soft Delete only when eligible; an Inquiry Cancelled banner and read-only state for cancelled quotes.

Read-only. Informs the provider of the acceptance outcome for each parent quote and its subquotes; only the selected provider sees the accepted selection; a non-selected reason never identifies another provider or the accepted price; links to version/audit history.

Admin monitors all subquote acceptance events with status filters (active, booking cancelled, superseded), views the immutable accepted selection, supersession or booking-cancelled indicator, flagged conflicts, and annotations, and adds audited notes or corrections with a reason. No delete or restore action exists.
